reason: Combines structured weight pruning and dynamic token pruning with an FPGA accelerator for DeiT-Small; reports up to 3.4x lower computation, 1.6x compression, and 12.8x latency reduction vs CPU with about 3% accuracy drop. Concrete transformer inference acceleration, but vision-only rather than LLM.
title: Accelerating ViT Inference on FPGA through Static and Dynamic Pruning
